Nintendo Switch games include Pokémon Champions, Animal Crossing: New Horizon, It Takes Two, Little Nightmares II, Luigi’s Mansion 3, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, Mario Party Superstars, Monster Hunter Rise, Moving Out 2, New Super Mario Bros. U Deluxe, Nintendo Switch Sports, Overcooked, Overcooked 2, Ring Fit Adventure, Super Mario Odyssey, Super Smash Bros Ultimate, and The Legend of Zelda: Breath of The Wild.
